literal_meaning: চড়া (ঝাঁঝালো বা শিশিরের মতো ঠান্ডা পদার্থ) পড়া (পড়ে যাওয়া)
figurative_meaning_en: to become insipid or dull; to become dry or lifeless
similar_in_english: the bloom is off the rose
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই ঘটনার পর তার মনে চড়া পড়ে গেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Frost has fallen on his heart.
After the incident, a chill has settled in his mind.
history: This idiom likely originates from the imagery of winter frost (চড়া) falling on vegetation, causing it to wither and become dry, metaphorically applied to emotional states in Bengali folklore and literature.
note: The idiom evokes rural winter experiences in Bengal, symbolizing emotional desolation.
